name: Design Thinking
id_mapping: ENGINEERING_ADAPTATION: FW numeric correspondence to AG; source explicitly illustrates FW-11

source_original.purpose: Orkestrasi empati pengguna, pendefinisian ulang masalah (*How Might We*), ideasi, dan prototipe cepat
source_original.inputs: Hasil observasi pengguna, titik friksi perjalanan pelanggan (*journey*)
source_original.outputs: Rumusan pertanyaan *How Might We (HMW)* dan spesifikasi eksperimen prototipe

activation_conditions: User requests Design Thinking or the orchestrator justifies it against the problem.
methodology: Define a bounded How Might We question
Ideate multiple approaches and select a testable assumption
Prototype and test against explicit learning criteria
tool_requirements: Host reasoning and resource reading; calculation tool when required.
evidence_requirements: Cite material claims; mark missing inputs UNKNOWN; do not reuse illustrative source conclusions.
limitations: Host-authored analysis requires behavioral evaluation; schema validity does not prove truth.
validation_criteria: Provide hmw or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide ideas or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide prototype or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide test_plan or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Use all distinctive methodology steps and identify missing evidence.
